scope: normal equations consistent with supplied bound statistics only
contribution_bundle: complete JSON list; exact raw SHA-256 independently retained
aggregation: ascending unique batch_id; math.fsum per scalar
regularization: lambda added once to each aggregate Gram diagonal
residual: per output column: ||A W_j - H_j||_inf / (||A||_inf * ||W_j||_inf + ||H_j||_inf); A=sum(G)+lambda*I
residual_arithmetic: math.fsum of binary64 products followed by negative aggregate rhs
symmetry_scale: max(1,abs(left),abs(right)); compare supplied Gram and yTy without averaging
zero_denominator: accept only an exactly zero residual
numeric_range: all inputs and required intermediates finite and either zero or normal binary64; a zero product of nonzero factors refuses
duplicate_batch_policy: refuse repeated batch_id even when bytes match; do not change ledger append idempotency
duplicate_sample_policy: refuse repeated stable sample SHA-256 within or across batches
